in_sanskrit.name: रामवतार
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: रामके वतारनाम (Rāmakē vatārānām) - Manifestation/incarnation of Lord Rama.

in_hindi.name: रामवतार
in_hindi.long_meaning: रामके वतारनाम (Rāmakē vatārānām) - रामकी अवतार (Rāmakī avatār) - रामका प्रारभ (Rāmakā prārabh) - Manifestation/incarnation of Lord Rama.

in_tamil.name: ராமவதர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ராமவதர் (Rāmavadhar) - ராமக்களின் வதர் (Rāmakkāḷiṉ vadhar) - ராமக்கோவின் அவதாரம் (Rāmakkōviṉ avadāram) - Manifestation/incarnation of Lord Rama.

in_telugu.name: రామవదర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: రామవదర్ (Rāmavadar) - రామప్రభదేశ్ (Rāmaprabhadeśa) - రామదేశ్ అవతారదు (Rāmadeśa avatāradu) - Manifestation/incarnation of Lord Rama.

in_marathi.name: Ramavtar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God in the form of Ram, with the qualities of a king or ruler
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramavtar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ram means 'God' and Avtar means 'manifestation' or 'descent'. This name is often given to a child born during the nine-day festival of Ram Navami, which is dedicated to Lord Ram, one of the principal deities of Hinduism. Ram is known for his courage, strength, and righteousness, and is considered an ideal of masculine power and leadership.
